subject.title: fix(auth): bind OAuth and sessions to immutable identity

question: What supported recovery contract should installations use for existing email-owned GitHub sessions and durable owner records after this security migration?
rationale: The PR deliberately invalidates legacy mutable identities, which is security-conscious but can interrupt existing access and ownership; choosing between explicit operator migration and forced recreation is a product and support policy decision.

options.title: Require operator-controlled migration
options.body: Provide a narrowly authorized, documented migration or recovery procedure that maps confirmed legacy records to immutable GitHub account owners without automatic email reassignment.

options.title: Approve recreation-only recovery
options.body: Keep the fail-closed behavior and explicitly support only fresh login plus recreation of legacy records, accepting the resulting operational interruption.

recommendation.title: Require operator-controlled migration
recommendation.body: Provide a narrowly authorized, documented migration or recovery procedure that maps confirmed legacy records to immutable GitHub account owners without automatic email reassignment.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent branch history shows direct ownership of the immutable-admin and migration-gap changes that define the recovery boundary.
